newsitem.title: CANADA: Ensign to buy 27 oil and gas drilling rigs.
newsitem.headline: Ensign to buy 27 oil and gas drilling rigs.

text.p: Ensign Resource Service Group Inc said on Monday that unit Ensign Drilling Inc entered into an agreement to buy the Canadian oil and gas drilling assets of Simmons Group Inc, a private, Alberta-based oil service contractor.
Ensign said the deal includes 27 drilling rigs and related assets. The value of the deal was not disclosed.
The purchase, expected to close on October 31, expands Ensign Group's total fleet in Canada and the United States to 117 rigs.
